notes: Adjusted dependency to ensure facade exposure occurs after service-level integration.

change_log.note: Facade should depend on integrated service output, not raw logic

stories.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for trial relevance including condition match, eligibility alignment, and overall relevance score. Extend Pydantic models to validate inputs and outputs.

stories.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria, producing normalized relevance signals.

stories.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate relevance scoring into evaluate_care_facade so trial search responses include structured relevance indicators for downstream rendering.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Relevance Matching Logic
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating condition matching, eligibility parsing, partial matches, service integration, and edge cases such as missing criteria.

stories.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Flow
stories.description: Embed relevance computation into clinical_trials_service pipeline so all returned trials include computed relevance before being passed to the facade.
